# T350-T450C CNT / Energy-Minimization Postprocess Report

## Scope

- 55 complete no-strain cases: T=350, 360, ..., 450 C and xB=0.030, 0.035, 0.040, 0.045, 0.050.
- Grid: 400 x 400 x 400; physical spacing: 0.1 nm.
- Each completed scan has the same-strain r=0 matrix reference plus 11 nonzero radius points.
- T360-T390 were postprocessed in this run from existing raw energy_minimize CSV files; no minimization was rerun.

## Definitions

- `r*_fit`: local fitted maximum of the same-reference-subtracted CNT curve.
- `DeltaG*_CNT,refsub`: physical conversion of `F_total_CNT_hat - F_total_ref_hat`, reported in kBT.
- `F*_CNT,fit,excess (hat)`: fitted code-energy barrier from the existing minimization table.

## Acceptance

- complete peak fits: 55/55
- missing physical-barrier rows: 0
- selected peak connected components: 1 for all 55 cases

## Artifacts

- `energy_minimization_T350_T450_complete.csv`: 55-row merged result table.
- `barrier_real_units_by_case.csv`: physical-unit barrier summary.
- `barrier_real_units_detail.csv`: all 605 nonzero radius points.
- `energy_minimization_T350_T450_overview.png` and `.pdf`: radius/barrier heatmaps and trends.
- `temperature_reports/`: one compact report per temperature.
